articles.title: CFTC chair claims Gemini case was politically motivated, seeks to reverse $5M settlement
articles.snippet: The CFTC chair seeks to roll back an enforcement action on the company founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, donors to Donald Trump’s 2024 campaign and attendees at White House events.

articles.title: Bernie Sanders, Elizabeth Warren Urge Labor Department to Drop Bitcoin, Crypto 401K Plan
articles.snippet: The senators said a plan allowing fiduciaries to offer exposure to riskier assets like crypto and private equity would hurt retirees and personally benefit President Trump.

articles.title: President Trump Signs AI Executive Order After Delaying It Over China Concerns
articles.snippet: Trump's executive order creates a voluntary framework for reviewing advanced AI models, expands AI-powered cybersecurity efforts, and more.

articles.title: Trump’s Business Partner Teases Future Meme Coin Plans: 'We’re The Biggest Brand on Earth'
articles.snippet: Bill Zanker, a longtime Trump associate, will take the top 19 holders of the president’s meme coin to the World Cup Finals next month—and has plans for ongoing exclusive events.

articles.title: How President Trump’s Immigration Order Will Feed the Stablecoin Economy, Bitcoin ATMs
articles.snippet: When the Trump family faced pressure from banks, it embraced crypto. Now, immigrants who are in the U.S. illegally face a similar choice.
